messages.subject: Project Willow - legal due diligence report (final)
messages.plaintextBody:
Catherine, Tom,

Attached is our final legal due diligence report. There are no deal-breakers. The four matters to note are the Pennine consent (a completion condition), the pending environmental permit variation, the Doyle employment matter (we recommend a specific indemnity capped at £75,000), and the open HMRC R&D enquiry (covered by the tax covenant and a £40,000 reserve in the completion accounts). Happy to talk it through.

Sarah
